summary: A static ToDesktop pricing page on a #fafafa background, 1244x996. At the top, centred, is a white pill nav bar (about 373-865 x 18-63) with a soft shadow. It holds a blue rounded-square logo, the links "Products ⌄ / Docs / Changelog / Blog", a white outlined "Log in" pill and a solid blue (#0147fe) "Sign up" pill. Below it, centred, is a grey segmented toggle (497-739 x 96-128): "Monthly" sits unselected in grey, and "Yearly" is selected on a white raised segment with a pale-blue "-20%" chip. Three plan columns sit side by side, each about 268 px wide with ~20 px gaps, from y≈173 to 789. Essential (x 197-465) and Scale (x 773-1041) are light grey (#f3f3f3) panels, each topped by a white rounded header card with a soft shadow holding the title and a two-line grey description. Performance (x 485-753) is the featured column: a near-black (#121212) panel with a #252525 header card. Each column shows a large grotesk price with slashed zeros ("$100", "$300", "$1,200") followed by a small grey "/ Month". Under the price is a full-width pill button: white with dark text on the light cards, blue (#0147fe) with white text on Performance. Next comes a faint dotted divider and an uppercase monospace label, then a list of features, each with a small grey glyph and a bold lead value where relevant. The lists hold 10, 10 and 6 rows, spaced 28.5 px apart. At the bottom, a full-width grey Enterprise band (197-1041 x 808-969) holds a white left card ("Enterprise", "Customised to suit your needs.", a dark charcoal gradient pill "Contact sales") and two columns of features (4 + 3 rows). Corners are rounded throughout: the panels have about a 16-20 px radius, and the buttons and nav are fully rounded. Nothing moves: difference views at 0-0.5, 0.5-1, 1-1.5, 1.5-2, 2-2.5 and 2.5-2.95 s show no change beyond compression specks, so the rebuild should hold one still frame for the full 3 s.

criteria.check: Page background is a flat near-white (#fafafa) with no gradient or texture
Nothing moves: the frame at 0.5s and the frame at 2.5s are identical (no fade, slide, hover or number change)
A white, fully rounded nav pill is horizontally centred, spanning about x 373-865 and y 18-63
Nav pill has a soft diffuse drop shadow, not a hard border line
Logo at the left of the nav is a blue rounded square (~24px) with a white rounded glyph inside, an original drawing with the same silhouette
Nav links read 'Products' (followed by a small down chevron), 'Docs', 'Changelog', 'Blog' in dark ~14px type
'Log in' is a white pill with a thin light-grey outline and dark text
'Sign up' is a solid bright blue (#0147fe) pill with white text at the right end of the nav
Segmented toggle is centred under the nav at about x 497-739, y 96-128
'Yearly' is the selected segment: a white raised rectangle with a faint shadow on a light grey track, while 'Monthly' sits in grey text on the track
Right segment reads 'Yearly' followed by a small pale-blue rounded chip with blue text '-20%'
Three plan columns of equal width (~268px) start at y≈173 and end at y≈789, at x≈197, 485 and 773
Middle Performance column is a near-black (#121212) rounded panel, while Essential and Scale are light grey
Performance header area is a slightly lighter charcoal (#252525) rounded card inset ~4px inside the black panel, ending at y≈292
Essential header is a white rounded card (radius ~16px) sitting on the grey column, with a soft shadow below it and no dark border
Header titles read 'Essential', 'Performance', 'Scale' at ~19px medium weight; Performance in white, the others near-black
Essential description reads 'For simple desktop apps and' / 'solo developers.' on two grey lines
Performance description reads 'For sophisticated desktop apps' / 'and small teams.' in light grey
Scale description reads 'For advanced features and' / 'dedicated support.'
Prices read '$100', '$300', '$1,200', each followed by a small grey '/ Month'
Price numerals are ~38px tall in a geometric grotesk with slashed zeros (a diagonal stroke inside each 0)
'$300' is white on the black panel
Each column has a 'Start free trial' pill about 210x36 at y≈373-409, inset ~29px from the column's left edge
Performance button is a fully rounded bright blue (#0147fe) pill with white centred text
Essential and Scale buttons are white fully rounded pills with near-black centred text and a faint shadow
A faint dotted (not solid) horizontal line runs under each button at y≈433, the button's width
Essential section label reads 'ESSENTIAL PLAN INCLUDES:' in small uppercase monospace grey
Performance label reads 'EVERYTHING IN ESSENTIAL, PLUS:' in monospace
Scale label reads 'EVERYTHING IN PERFORMANCE, PLUS:' in monospace
Essential lists exactly 10 feature rows, from y≈495 to y≈751
Performance lists exactly 10 feature rows, from y≈495 to y≈751
Scale lists exactly 6 feature rows, ending at 'Integration assistance' (y≈637), with empty grey panel below
Feature rows are evenly spaced about 28.5px apart
Essential rows begin '30 day build retention', '10,000 downloads/month', 'Unlimited App Updates', where '30 day', '10,000' and 'Unlimited' are bold and darker

Essential continues 'Windows, Mac & Linux build servers', 'Code signing', 'Native app installers', 'Native module rebuilding', 'Automated Electron code analysis', 'CDN-backed downloads/updates', 'Download links on your domain'

Performance rows read '60 day build retention', '30,000 downloads/month', 'Staging and dev apps', 'Auto-update smoke testing', 'Windows & Mac web installers', 'Private Slack-channel support', 'MSI and PKG installers', 'Microsoft and Mac app store', 'Download analytics', 'Build analytics'
On the black panel, bold values ('60 day', '30,000') are white and the rest of the row text is mid grey
Scale rows read '360 day build retention', '100,000 downloads/month', 'Support for staggered rollouts', 'Account manager', 'Priority support & onboarding', 'Integration assistance'
Each feature row starts with a small (~14px) grey monochrome glyph (an original approximation), such as a clock-on-box for retention and a cloud-download for downloads
Glyphs are flat grey (not coloured), dimmer than the row text
A full-width light grey rounded Enterprise band spans x≈197-1041, y≈808-969, below the three columns
Left part of the band is a white rounded card (~276px wide) with a soft shadow
Card reads 'Enterprise' (~19px) above grey 'Customised to suit your needs.'
'Contact sales' is a dark charcoal (#363636-#444) fully rounded pill about 220x37 with white text and a subtle top-to-bottom sheen
First Enterprise column (x≈520) reads 'Unlimited build retention', 'Custom billing', 'Optional self-host infra', 'Team training & Code reviews', with 'Unlimited' bold
Second Enterprise column (x≈768) reads 'Unlimited downloads/month', 'Custom features', 'Guaranteed response SLA'
The plan columns and the Enterprise band share the same left (x≈197) and right (x≈1041) edges and are centred in the 1244px frame
